Outline · not written yet

This is the planned structure of the chapter, published so the curriculum can be reviewed before the prose is written. Each heading below becomes a section; the last section is what you will build and test. About 70 minutes when written.

9.1 · Three formats

pointwise scores, pairwise preference, rubric checklists; what each can detect.

9.2 · Measured biases

position, verbosity, self-preference, and style over substance.

9.3 · Debiasing

order swaps, length control, reference answers, and a judge from another model family.

9.4 · Thinking judges

reasoning before the verdict, its cost, and calibration of the vote.

9.5 · Prompting a judge

criteria, scales, examples, and forcing a decision.

What you build

A judge harness that runs both orders, controls for length, and logs every rationale. Every number it produces is asserted by a test, and the chapter's companion notebook recomputes it.
